When adding new features, update the README.md file with a short description of the feature written in Polish, in the Features section (or its equivalent if the section does not exist).
Use English for variables and file names.
If a name comes from the project's domain terminology, use its English equivalent defined in README.md; do not create mixed Polish-English names.
Function names must also be in English.
Code comments may be in Polish.
Constants must also be in English.
Class names must also be in English.
Module names must also be in English.
Function argument names must also be in English.
Folder and file names must also be in English.
Text visible to the end user (UI labels, on-screen messages, error messages shown to the user) must be in Polish. Write logs and technical messages for developers in English.
